input.prompt: Using this soldier character only as a colour reference (olive green, dark gunmetal, small cyan accents), draw a single game prop on its own in a realistic, photoreal 3D render style with physically based materials, NOT comic or cel-shaded, no outlines, so it sits naturally on realistic jungle ground and rock textures. A steep jungle rock outcrop: a tall jagged cliff of dark grey weathered granite slabs, about 6 metres long, 4 metres deep and 6 metres tall, with sheer near-vertical faces, sharp overhanging fractured edges and a pointed irregular top, wet dark streaks and patches of moss. It must look impassable and unclimbable, no ledges and no flat steps. Clean three-quarter front view from slightly above. No character, no person, no plants on the ground around it, nothing else. Whole object visible with margin, transparent background, no shadow, no text.
